# Sarker Trims Ltd. - Comprehensive Technical Dossier

## Dedicated Manufacturing Categories

### 1. Draw Cords & Drawstrings
- Styles: Round braided cord, flat braided cord, knitted draw cord, hollow cord, core-filled cord, reflective safety cord, two-tone patterned cord.
- Diameters & Sizes: 3 mm to 12 mm width/diameter, custom lengths cut to specification.
- Materials: 100% combed cotton, spun polyester, filament polyester, textured polyester, nylon, bright polypropylene (PP).
- Tipping & Aglet Options:
  - Transparent and colored cellulose acetate heat-shrink aglets.
  - Custom metal aglets: zinc alloy and brass in matte black, gunmetal, shiny chrome, brushed brass, antique bronze with custom laser engraving or embossed logo.
  - Silicone-dipped ends: soft-touch rubberized tips in custom Pantone shades.
  - Folded heat-sealed ends and stitched tip finishes.
- Performance: High knot-retention, wash-fastness grade 4-5, anti-fray tensile resistance.
- Lead Times: 1 Day for counter-sample, 3 Days for bulk production after lab dip approval.

### 2. Plain Elastic Bands
- Weave & Construction: Knitted elastic, woven needle-loom elastic, braided elastic, buttonhole elastic, non-roll waistband elastic.
- Width Range: 6 mm to 150 mm (up to 15 cm).
- Elongation & Stretch: 120% to 160% elongation with 98%+ stretch recovery memory.
- Yarn Composition: Textured polyester yarn, nylon yarn, combined with high-grade heat-resistant natural rubber and Lycra/Spandex filament cores.
- Applications: Waistbands for boxer shorts, athletic track pants, cycling shorts, underwear, swimwear, and jacket cuffs.
- Features: Non-curling, skin-friendly, chlorine-resistant, resistant to repeated commercial laundering at 60 degrees C.
- Lead Times: 1 Day for counter-sample, 3 Days for bulk production.

### 3. Jacquard Elastic Webbing
- Technology: Computerized high-speed jacquard needle looms with electronic pattern controllers.
- Width Range: 15 mm to 55 mm (up to 5.5 cm).
- Visual Effects: Custom brand name typography, repeating geometric motifs, relief 3D jacquard textures, reversible double-face weaves, lurex metallic highlights.
- Materials: High-tenacity micro-polyester, nylon 66, and double-covered spandex threads.
- Finishing: Heat-set finishing preventing post-wash shrinkage and edge curling.
- Applications: Luxury underwear waistbands, branded compression leggings, activewear training shorts, sports bras.
- Lead Times: 1 Day for counter-sample, 3 Days for bulk production.

### 4. Needle Loom Twill Tapes
- Weaves: Traditional herringbone chevron weave, plain weave, twill weave, grosgrain ribbing, tubular binding tape.
- Width Range: 6 mm to 50 mm.
- Materials: 100% organic cotton, recycled polyester (GRS compliant upon request), spun polyester, nylon.
- Dyeing: Vat and reactive piece dyeing with Pantone TPX/TCX color matching, Oeko-Tex Standard 100 compliance.
- Applications: Garment back neck seam reinforcement tape, polo shirt collar tape, side vent binding, apron ties, shoulder stay tape.
- Lead Times: 1 Day for counter-sample, 3 Days for bulk production.

### 5. Printed & Woven Items
- Products: High-density damask woven brand labels, satin printed care tags, heat-transfer neck labels, taffeta size pips, woven badges, custom printed ribbons.
- Weave Quality: 50D and 75D micro-yarn damask looms for ultra-crisp micro-typography and fine graphic definitions.
- Cuts & Folds: Ultrasonic cut (soft scratch-free edge), end fold, center fold, mitre fold, Manhattan fold, laser die-cut shapes.
- Lead Times: 3 Days for physical sample, 7 Days for bulk manufacturing.

### 6. Corrugated Export Carton Boxes
- Flute Profiles: B-flute, C-flute, E-flute, BC-flute (double wall), and heavy-duty 7-ply combinations.
- Wall Types: 3-Ply single wall, 5-Ply double wall export shipping cartons, 7-Ply heavy industrial containers.
- Paper Substrates: Premium virgin kraft liner, semi-chemical fluting medium, test liner (125 GSM to 170 GSM).
- Specifications: High Edge Crush Test (ECT), Bursting Strength (Mullen test compliant), Cobb 60 water absorption tested.
- Printing: Flexographic single-color and multi-color printing for export shipping marks, bar-codes, handling symbols, and brand artwork.
- Lead Times: 12 Hours for physical structural sample, 3 Days for bulk production.

## Production Machinery Fleet
- Multi-head computerized jacquard needle looms.
- High-speed narrow fabric needle looms for twill tapes and plain elastics.
- Multi-spindle automatic draw cord braiding and knitting machines.
- Semi-automatic and pneumatic tipping machines for metal, silicone, and acetate aglets.
- Flexographic carton box printing, slotting, die-cutting, and rotary creasing converting machines.
- Laboratory equipment: Tensile strength tester, wash-fastness crockmeter, electronic yarn twist tester, digital GSM scales.

## Sustainability & Quality Control
- 100% inspection protocol: Every lot undergoes dimensional verification, elongation testing, and visual checks before packaging.
- Raw material compliance: Free from banned AZO dyes, heavy metals, formaldehyde, and harmful phthalates.
- Packaging: Moisture-proof inner polybags with sturdy corrugated master outer cartons for damage-free transit to factory docks.
